Card Q&A.q: When my Digimon with [Greymon] in its name isn't affected by my opponent's Digimon's effects from this card's [Main] effect, can it be blocked by an opponent's Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: No, it isn't affected. [Security] effects on Security Digimon are treated as Digimon effects, so the "this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon" effect prevents such effects from affecting this Digimon.
